scope: EUR nominal-rate scenarios using actual lender/assessor/notary quotes. No universal EU tax/LTV/DTI policy, static bank tariff or live rate feed is invented.
corrections: Zero-interest amortization and capped last payment
No automatic seven-percent savings haircut or statutory income multiple
No universal 35% approval grade or non-resident rate uplift
No automatic 20% deposit or average notary/transfer tax
No random FX trends or synthetic benchmark historical peaks
Euribor input is a contractual fixing plus margin, not ECB policy rate; only a selected actual all-in floor applies
ECB reference FX is informational, not an executable transfer rate
